scope: Independent read-only exact plan and baseline source review. Only these review artifacts written. No tests, network, inference, service, process, UI or audio actions.

checks.rationale: Availability comes from trusted catalogue and validated snapshot, not prompt or model. Validate every visible source ID against availability, including empty-card pages; source_reference_map alone omits empty pages. Shared helper narrows original source enum and retains all other parameter constraints.

Live includes issued plus confirmed unpromoted pending page once; replay uses current generation read prefix. Unconfirmed observation remains rejected. Empty cards do not count, repeated source counts once, and used is a strict int in 0..6.

After four card-bearing same-source reads, used=4 covered=1 yields remaining=missing=2 and excludes that source. Fifth distinct source yields remaining=missing=1 and preserves third-source opportunity. Empty-card selection may still make completion impossible; plan promises opportunity, not guaranteed facts. Feasible six-read plus write plus ACK remains eight POST. No source order, facts, page start, budget, or model is imposed by helper.

Fixed prewrite refusal rejects false saved claims without granting delivery. ACK keeps existing bounded schema only after verified-file gate. Public failure states non-delivery, preserves partial-effect caveat and does not claim absent file. Existing proof and artifact gates remain required.

Plan requires real SDK with MockTransport and real temporary artifact/write/ACK/replay, not mocked success. Old fifth same-source action must fail at strict schema and not dispatch. Replay tampering must preserve surrounding hashes/links enough to target phase schema checks. Supplement moving valid max-length private final to ACK then synthetic independent-artifact failure is compatible with plan lines 24/38-39; keep bounded/private and new arbitrary-prewrite rejection tests.

implementation_acceptance_notes: Source/schema equality and trusted-source rejection must be verified by fresh tests; this review executes none.
Do not treat prewrite refusal as a successful runtime proof; existing replay verifier accepts writer and authorized ACK transcripts, not delivery from refusal.
Ensure malicious replay changes cannot widen available IDs even when prompt/catalogue-looking text or claimed strict schema is altered.
Keep original SDK tool spec unchanged; deep-copy narrow schema so no shared mutation persists.
